status: Frozen first engineering run; not the publication confirmation protocol
purpose: Exercise the directional point candidate from raw counts through normalization, filtering, paired directional tests, joint BH, detection and latent-effect assessment at transcriptome scale
release_scope: Large independent-patient bulk RNA-seq cohorts; uncertainty kernels deferred

candidate.normalization: RLE fit once on the complete count matrix, before a label-invariant test filter
candidate.multiplicity: BH over all finite gene-direction p-values together; separately score unique-gene discoveries
candidate.noise: none; exact ties and zero counts retained
candidate.null: Label exchangeability conditional on the frozen normalization, pooled filter and design; no composite stochastic-order null is claimed

baseline: Current public unsigned log-W1, identical counts, fitted factors, test mask, label stream seed and permutation cap; own one-test-per-gene BH family

engineering.generator: Independent Gamma biological abundances with gene-specific CV-squared 0.2 to 1.0; independent lognormal exposures with log-SD 0.35, geometric mean one; Poisson counts. Background means log-uniform 0.05 to 1000. First 64 genes are known unchanged, abundant controls. One all-zero row checks exclusion.
engineering.membership: Subset membership is drawn independently of baseline abundance, saved, and never inferred from a maximum walk. Singleton is a failure-boundary sentinel.
engineering.truth: Unchanged generating distributions define the gene null; finite-cohort latent abundances define realized area and mean-ratio estimation targets. One dataset per panel cannot estimate FDR reliably.
endpoints: raw TP FP TN FN and sensitivity/specificity
wrong-direction calls in ordered bulk changes
linear directional area error versus finite-cohort latent truth
mean log2-ratio error without a hidden pseudocount
actual permutation usage and attainable p-value floor

next_gate: Audit these instruments, then freeze the replicated benchmark grid and fresh confirmation seeds before inspecting confirmation outcomes. Compare native DESeq2/edgeR and point representations on matched input matrices; patient-level OUTRIDER questions remain separate. PLAN.md defines the publication work and acceptance policy.
